title: the thirteen instructions that trap in U-mode: what the trap costs, and what the operations cost instead
question: Q128 section 5 item 5: thirteen instructions trap in U-mode and have no energy figure
registered_by: kern-dev (Q129 workflow), on aifoundry1: build, firmware source reading and dry run only
card_state: 600 MHz pinned; harts 1; probe items --window 0 --seconds 0.001 (one launch, one 64-op block)

structural_finding.claim: there is no emulation path, so no per-instruction energy exists for these thirteen
evidence: device-minion-runtime/src/MachineMinion/src/trap_routine.c: EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION is emulated only for csrrs mhartid; everything else sets delegate = true and returns stvec

device-minion-runtime/src/WorkerMinion/src/exception.c exception_handler: for a U-mode exception it saves the context, evicts the S-mode and U-mode trace buffers, sends CM_TO_MM_MESSAGE_ID_KERNEL_EXCEPTION once per shire, and calls return_from_kernel(0, KERNEL_RETURN_EXCEPTION)
so one trapping instruction ends that hart's kernel; it never returns to mepc+4
structural_finding.source: Apache-2.0, installed on the lab boxes at /opt/et-platform; counted ELFs at /opt/et/lib/esperanto-fw/*/

not_on_this_path.note: the ecall path and the management side

counted_27_oct_2026_aifoundry1.consequence: in a U-mode kernel on this silicon a float a/b is safe (299 instructions of libgcc soft float) and sqrtf(x) is fatal (libm's own fdiv.s)

P1_all_thirteen_trap.rule: trp_ of a trapping mode records ok:false with zero ops; every trp_tr_ctl_* records ok:true with 64 ops

predictions.P2_build_independence: trx_fdiv_ps and trx_fsqrt_ps (the catalogue's own hand-written modes) behave as their tr. counterparts
predictions.P4_no_lasting_harm: controls after a trapping launch in the same block still record ok:true; et-who clean; the pass ends ok. A card that stops answering is a FAIL, reported as one

P5_no_energy_figure.note: a count at 6-11 pJ per instruction, NOT a measurement; the board meter is 3-4 orders of magnitude short

P6_substitute_price.sqrt: not callable from libm; needs frcp.ps or a hand-written iteration

decision.P1_is_a_count: each item's verdict is the modal ok over passes; a non-unanimous item is reported unstable with its per-pass values
decision.P3_instrument: median wall_s difference over passes with the full range; the host clock, not the board meter; process startup removed by differencing against the control in the same block
decision.stop_rule: if a control after a trapping launch does not record ok:true, the queue stops (build/tr-STOP), the claim stays open, notify.py --unblock is used. NO card reset, NO driver reload, NO PCIe retrain, ever
decision.L_strand: a trl_ item is launched only for a mode the probe cleared, named explicitly

waterfall: closes the second half of section 5 item 5 with a structural answer instead of thirteen energies; does not move the 3.837 pJ unaccounted on the multiply-add
